title: Necromunda — Campaign Systems (all 8, consolidated)
site: NecroRAW (necroraw.com.ru) — volunteer Docusaurus consolidation of published Necromunda rules across ~24 official Games Workshop books. robots: noindex, nofollow (firecrawl_map returns nothing; pages reached only by following links). NOT to be confused with the dead necroraw.ru (no .com), which now serves an unrelated adult link-farm.
licence_note: Rules text transcribed from copyrighted Games Workshop publications by the NecroRAW volunteer project for personal reference. Quoted here for analysis/critique under fair use; no whole rulebook reproduced. Third-party rulebook PDFs used for cross-check (book-of-the-outcast.pdf, book-of-judgement.pdf, core-rulebook.pdf, ash-wastes.pdf) are pre-staged in the sibling research/sources/necromunda/ folder (shared with a concurrent capture of Necromunda's core rules) and are gitignored — not committed.

cross_check.method: PyMuPDF (fitz) get_text('text') on the exact page indices, diffed by eye against the NecroRAW markdown capture
cross_check.result: Verbatim match on every checked page — Settlement Locations table, Starting Structures rules, the three location-based Structure caps, and all 24 rows of the Supply/Building/Defence Structure tables.
